title: Your mates, as fighters
text: Every friend gets a type, stats and signature moves built from your in-jokes. Kai is a speed type, and his gym is a timber yard you climb with ramps you build yourself.

label: MAP
title: Your town becomes the map
text: The flat, the beach, the bar you always end up in, laid out from your own photos. You are standing {place} right now.

label: STORY
title: The night everyone still talks about
text: Lost passports, a missed flight, a stag do gone sideways. You tell us the story and it becomes the main quest. You are walking as Rico, and his passport goes missing first.

title: The thing he always does is now an attack
text: Tell us what everyone always does. Elias got a mic and a move called Siren Song. Your mate might get a golf swing, a camera flash or a very long voice note.

title: The dog is in the squad
text: Nala is in the game as herself: same face, same tongue. A pet can be a companion, a gym guard or, if she earned it, the final boss.

title: Three steps to your squad’s game
steps: Photos, your places and the in-jokes.
A playable preview in about three weeks, with two rounds of changes.
A private link that runs in any browser, on the same wifi.
